### Day 276: Acts 21:1–6
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-276-acts-21-16.html
Passage: Acts 21:1-6
Points:
- God often places unexpected blessings during unplanned delays in our journeys.
- Believers scattered by earlier persecution welcomed Paul and demonstrated genuine Christian hospitality.
- Fellowship in Christ quickly establishes deep, affectionate bonds of mutual love and concern.
- Whole families gathered on the beach to kneel together in heartfelt farewell prayer.
- The enduring spiritual power of faithful intercession outlasts any physical traces left behind.
